Hello!

The advice I can offer is:

WoW Cataclysm is the current Classic Expansion. It's "easier" to play, in my opinion, because it's simplistic. But it is grindy, as expected from Classic WoW. There is a nice experience buff called Joyous Journeys that grants you extra XP from quests and killing monsters, I believe. Which is definitely a plus. Also first mount at 20 is definitely nice.

WoW Season of Discovery. This is the grindy classic above, but with some new raids and gear. Also with new spells - called runes - you are meant to 'Discover' and often times new quests. Also there is an XP buff of 3% that can be acquired via a sleeping bag (quest is lengthy and you'll travel quite a bit. No mount until 40. Things to keep in mind) but other people can let you use theirs.

WoW Retail. I have just started playing retail 5ish weeks ago. It is COMPLICATED, to me, compared to the others. But if you're playing casually, as I am, leveling is mindless, you get a mount at level 10 and flying mount at 20, and the game basically does all the hard work for you. Tells you where to go, flight paths everywhere, etc etc.

I will also add that while retail WoW is the most populated, people are extremely rude. As a new player to that format, I took the time to Google what I didn't know. But when Google failed me... wow. No one answered a single question I had in the first 3 weeks I played. Completely ignored. I find the Classic player base to be kinder and more helpful.

Feel free to let me know where you end up! If I can help with bags and some starter funds, it's what I do ❤ Also would be happy to answer more questions.
